text_block_list.text:
I inform Нарита Брайан of some sudden
changes to
her training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: I was just thinking you took that pretty well.

text_block_list.text: Who do you take me for?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
If there's good reason for making a
change, I'll
accept it. That's only natural.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: I haven't even explained the reason yet...

text_block_list.text:
...You haven't said anything that doesn't
make
sense to me before.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Your actions always lead to the desired
outcome.
I assumed that would be the
case this time as well.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Don't make me start regretting it now,
all right?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан seems to be satisfied with
the results
of her training.
